hints.title: Join Customer Orders
hints.text: Join the Customers table with Purchases on customer_id to associate dates and amounts.

hints.title: Distinct Month Counting
hints.text: Extract year-month representations from purchase dates and count distinct occurrences per customer.

hints.title: Aggregated Filter Criteria
hints.text: Enforce both active month and total expenditure minimums within the group filter clause.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(p.purchase_date, '%Y-%m')) AS active_months,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Purchases p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(p.purchase_date, '%Y-%m')) >= 3
   AND SUM(p.amount) >= 500.00
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Hash or index join grouped by customer identifier.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per customer incur repetitive scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Aggregates grouped purchases in a single table pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Format dates and use COUNT(DISTINCT ...) with HAVING filters.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(p.purchase_date, '%Y-%m')) AS active_months,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Purchases p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(p.purchase_date, '%Y-%m')) >= 3
   AND SUM(p.amount) >= 500.00
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(p.purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM')) AS active_months,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Purchases p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(p.purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM')) >= 3
   AND SUM(p.amount) >= 500.00
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;
